scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme-1
other_conditions: Only one girl from a family is eligible
The boy must be at least 21 years old
Marriage must be conducted from 17th May 2011 onwards
Bride must have studied up to 10th Standard (or a Scheduled Tribe bride with a minimum of 5th Standard)
In case of death of parents, assistance is given to the daughter
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹25,000 and an 8‑gram gold coin
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
